item.text:
**6B.3 Verdict**
Mixed, leaning no. Sisi’s 2024 record includes real targeted support for poor households, women, children, and some refugees, but it also includes policies and practices that harmed or excluded vulnerable groups, especially refugees and asylum-seeking children. The strongest positive evidence is in cash transfers and women-focused inclusion; the strongest negative evidence is on refugee treatment and access barriers.

- **World Bank Group statement of support to Egypt’s development and reform efforts** — World Bank Group — 2024-03-18 — [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/statement/2024/03/18/world-bank-group-statement-of-support-to-egypt-s-development-and-reform-efforts) — The 2024 reform agenda was explicitly framed around inclusive growth, human capital, resilience, and protection of the poorest and most vulnerable. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **IMF staff agreement on Egypt reviews under the EFF** — IMF — 2024-03-06 — [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/03/06/pr-2459-egypt-staff-and-authorities-reach-agreement-on-reviews-under-the-eff-arrangement) — The authorities agreed to more social spending for vulnerable groups and a larger cash-transfer package, which is direct evidence of targeted protection. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **Promoting Inclusive Human Capital Development and Building Resilience in Egypt through Cash Transfer Programs** — World Bank — 2024-05-28 — [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs) — Takaful and Karama was described as supporting poor households, children, the elderly poor, widows, orphans, and persons with disabilities, with health/education conditions, child nutrition support, and a 55 percent benefit increase in 2023/2024. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **Women’s Empowerment Strategy 2030** — State Information Service — 2024-03-12 — [URL](https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/strategies/womens-empowerment-strategy-2030/) — Sisi assigned the women’s empowerment strategy to government and state agencies as a working document, and the strategy emphasized equal opportunity, labor participation, rights, and social integration for women. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **Minister: Labor ministry has strategy to empower women** — State Information Service — 2024-03-23 — [URL](https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/minister-labor-ministry-has-strategy-to-empower-women/) — The labor ministry said it had a women’s empowerment strategy at Sisi’s direction, including training, job placement, a gender-equality unit, and measures to reduce discrimination against women at work. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **House of Representatives approves drafted Social Solidarity bill** — State Information Service — 2024-12-01 — [URL](https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/house-of-representatives-approves-drafted-social-solidarity-bill/) — The government-backed bill aimed to unify support programs and empower the most needy to ensure a “decent life for all,” reinforcing a welfare-oriented framing. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **Launch of the Joint UN Programme under the Joint Platform for Migrants and Refugees in Egypt** — UNHCR Egypt — 2024-09-30 — [URL](https://www.unhcr.org/eg/news/launch-joint-un-programme-under-joint-platform-migrants-and-refugees-egypt) — Egypt, the UN, and the EU launched a program to support health and education for refugees and migrants in vulnerable situations, explicitly aimed at less advantaged host and displaced communities. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **Egypt: Authorities must end campaign of mass arrests and forced returns of Sudanese refugees** — Amnesty International — 2024-06-19 — [URL](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-authorities-must-end-campaign-of-mass-arrests-and-forced-returns-of-sudanese-refugees/) — Amnesty documented mass arbitrary arrests of Sudanese refugees, including women and children, cruel detention conditions, and forced returns without asylum access; this is strong evidence against prioritizing vulnerable groups. IDs: 6B.3
- **Egypt: Education Restricted for Refugees** — Human Rights Watch — 2024-12-02 — [URL](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees) — HRW found tens of thousands of refugee and asylum-seeking children out of school because of residency barriers, costs, and discrimination, showing weak real-world access for a key vulnerable group. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **Egypt: New law threatens to reduce access to healthcare for millions** — Amnesty International — 2024-07-30 — [URL](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-new-law-threatens-to-reduce-access-to-healthcare-for-millions/) — Amnesty said Law 87 of 2024 privatized public health facilities without price regulation, risking reduced access for uninsured and poor people. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2
- **World Report 2024: Egypt** — Human Rights Watch — 2024 — [URL](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/egypt) — HRW said Egypt’s June visa requirement made it harder for Sudanese women, children, and older people to flee conflict, increasing risk for vulnerable groups rather than prioritizing them. IDs: 6B.3
- **Egypt: President al-Sisi must reject new asylum law which violates refugee rights** — Amnesty International — 2024-12-03 — [URL](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/egypt-president-al-sisi-must-reject-new-asylum-law-which-violates-refugee-rights/) — Amnesty said the new asylum law restricted asylum rights and failed to protect education, housing, and social security rights for refugees and asylum seekers. IDs: 6B.3, 6B.2

**Search gap**
- I found strong 2024 evidence for women, poor households, children, elderly people, persons with disabilities, and refugees.
- I did not find comparably strong direct evidence that Sisi meaningfully prioritized ethnic/religious minorities or poor regions as distinct groups in 2024, beyond broader welfare and refugee measures.
- The record is also uneven: targeted social protection exists on paper and in programs, but refugee access barriers and health-care privatization cut against a broad vulnerability-first posture.
